overall: The AG found the Board violated G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a) by entering executive session on August 9, 2010 for an improper purpose (evaluating the Town Administrator's professional competence); the Board's cure was credited, but training and open-session orders issued.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session on August 9, 2010 for a 'preliminary employee evaluation,' a purpose not allowed under the Open Meeting Law, to evaluate the Town Administrator.
allegations.key_passage: This is not now a proper purpose for executive session under the Open Meeting Law, nor was it a proper purpose under the repealed version of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Each member of the Board receive and review a copy of this determination, the Open Meeting Law (G.L. c. 30A, §§18-25), and the Attorney General's Guide to the Open Meeting Law.
All future discussions about professional competence conducted by the Town be conducted in properly noticed open session meetings of the Board.
remedy_passage: We further order that all future discussions about professional competence conducted by the Town be conducted in properly noticed open session meetings of the Board.
